content.value: A simple sentence has one independent clause. A compound sentence connects independent clauses using coordinating conjunctions (FANBOYS).
परीक्षा टिप्स: सेतु श्रृंखला के मुख्य सूत्रों और बिंदुओं को बार-बार दोहराएं।

mcqs.question: Which conjunction is part of FANBOYS?
mcqs.explanation: For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So form FANBOYS.
